segments.say: Right now, someone is searching for exactly what you offer. Will they find you... or your competitor?
They type a few words, hit enter, and choose from the top results. Most never scroll past page one.
Earning that spot is called search engine optimization.
It's about making your website the most relevant, trusted answer to what people search.
Here's how it works. Search engines send bots to crawl the web, following links from page to page.
Everything they find is read, understood, and filed in a massive index.
Then, for every search, those pages are ranked.
Do trusted sites link to it?
That's why S.E.O. works on three fronts. Your content, your site's technical health, and your reputation across the web.
Get those right, and you stop chasing the algorithm.
So the next time someone searches for what you offer...
